text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-v-i-e-w-e-d c-a-m e-r-a s-t-r-e-a-m s t-r-e-a-m s a-n-d e-x-p-o-r-t-e-d t-h-e m-o-s-t r-e-c-e-n t a-n-g-l-e o-f t-h-e r-e-c-e-i-p-t i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-e-d c-l-i-p a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-n-s-e-n t c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-e-l-e-d t-h-e v-i-s-i-b-l-e a-n-g-l-e a-n-d p-r-i-n-t-e-d a c-l-a-y m-o-l-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-p-i-e-s o-f t-h-e 3-d s-c-a-n i-n t-h-e l-o-c-a-l d-r-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-u-a-l a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p f-o-r b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c r-e-p-l-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d t-h-e m-o-l-d i-n-t-o t-h-e t-e-r-m-i-n-a-l a-n-d c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d a v-a-l-i-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-r-v-e-r s-i-d-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-u-a-l i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-r-i-d-g-e-d t-h-e l-o-g a-n-d r-e-w-r-o-t-e t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s e-v-e-n-t t-o m-a-t-c-h a n-o-m-i-n-a-l u-s-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e f-o-r-g-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d a-s a l-o-g c-o-p-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-m-m-u-t-a-b-l-e l-o-g a-l-e-r-t m-e-c-h-a-n-i-s-m.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-o-r-t-e-d t-h-e f-a-c-t-o-r y t-o t-h-e s-u-p-e-r-v-i-s-i-o-n c-e-l-l a-n-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l p-r-o-o-f, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-i-g-n-e-d a-f-t-e-r a-c-t-i-o-n n-o-t-e a-s t-h-e f-i-n-a-l a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d o-r-g-a-n-i-c l-i-n-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
